title: ollama-cria restore map (00-RESTORE-MAP.json)
description: Written by tools/Collect-StackSecrets.ps1 into the secrets bundle and read by tools/Restore-StackSecrets.ps1. One row per file in the bundle. Holds names, logical destinations, sizes and hashes only: never a secret value. Review finding C-08: one versioned format for both ends.

formatVersion.description: Bump on any breaking change. Restore refuses a version it does not know.

inventory.description: Binds the map to the secret inventory it was collected from, so a map that leaves out a required row cannot pass. The restorer compares it with the inventory it receives from the repo.

sha256.description: SHA-256 of manifests/secrets.json as the collector read it, lower-case hex.

required.description: Ids of every required inventory row. Each must have a required entry in this map, and no other entry may be required.

id.description: Stable name for the row, unique in the map.

folder.description: Bundle folder (docs/RESTORE.md Stage 4b). 06 was removed in v0.3.

file.description: Path of the file inside its bundle folder, using '/'.

destination.description: Logical destination '<root>:<relative path>'. Roots are defined in manifests/recovery-roots.json; raw absolute paths are never allowed (C-49).

sha256.description: Full SHA-256 of the file, lower-case hex.

required.description: A missing required row stops the restore; a missing optional row only warns (C-07).

mode.description: Linux file mode for VPS and Docker volume destinations, for example 0600.

owner.description: Linux owner for VPS and Docker volume destinations: a user name, or a numeric uid inside a volume.

group.description: Linux group for VPS and Docker volume destinations: a group name, or a numeric gid inside a volume.
